record.notes: Released for public comment by the TC260 Secretariat with notice 网安秘字〔2026〕119号 of 18 Sept 2026; comments were due by 2 Oct 2026. The draft is version v1.0-202609 and carries the number TC260-PG-2026NA. It covers software agentic AI systems built on large models, not agentic systems whose main function is controlling physical devices such as robots or autonomous vehicles. Its bibliography lists AI Safety Governance Framework 2.0 (CN-13) and TC260's practice guide on the security of deploying and using agents (CN-26).

verification.note: Recheck of 18 Oct 2026. Stored and read: the TC260 Secretariat's notice of 18 Sept 2026 (tc260.org.cn, copy of 14 Oct 2026, unchanged when the archiver checked it on 18 Oct 2026) and the draft PDF attached to it (31 pages). Title, issuer, date, notice number, comment deadline and contents are confirmed from these; the summary follows the Chinese text. The comment period closed on 2 Oct 2026. TC260's home page (tc260.org.cn, stored in this run on 18 Oct 2026) lists the latest notices of 13 Oct, 18 Sept and 15 Sept 2026; the newest notice on this guide is still the call for comments of 18 Sept, so no final version had been released by 18 Oct 2026. The archiver flagged the home page for review because it barely mentions the guide's title; it is a list page and is used only for that. No English version was found.
